+"""Standalone copy of ``_pytest.junitxml.mangle_test_address``.
+
+This module is importable by file path without loading ``_pytest`` or its
+runtime initialization.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+import types
+
+
+__all__ = ["vendored_test_address", "vendored_test_address_variant"]
+
+
+# Copied from ``_pytest.nodes.SEP``.
+nodes = types.SimpleNamespace(SEP="/")
+
+
+def vendored_test_address(address: str) -> list[str]:
+    path, possible_open_bracket, params = address.partition("[")
+    names = path.split("::")
+    # Convert file path to dotted path.
+    names[0] = names[0].replace(nodes.SEP, ".")
+    names[0] = re.sub(r"\.py$", "", names[0])
+    # Put any params back.
+    names[-1] += possible_open_bracket + params
+    return names
+
+
+def vendored_test_address_variant(address: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    """Like :func:`vendored_test_address`, but return a tuple."""
+    return tuple(vendored_test_address(address))

+# mypy: allow-untyped-defs
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+from types import ModuleType
+
+import pytest
+
+
+MODULE_PATH = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "src" / "standalone_wave6_test_address.py"
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def mod() -> ModuleType:
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+        "standalone_wave6_test_address_under_test", MODULE_PATH
+    )
+    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+def test_no_pytest_dependency() -> None:
+    import ast
+
+    tree = ast.parse(MODULE_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    imported = set()
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
+            imported.update(alias.name for alias in node.names)
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
+            imported.add(node.module or "")
+    assert imported == {"__future__", "re", "types"}
+
+
+def test_exports_and_local_nodes(mod: ModuleType) -> None:
+    assert mod.nodes.SEP == "/"
+    assert set(mod.__all__) == {
+        "vendored_test_address",
+        "vendored_test_address_variant",
+    }
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("address", "expected"),
+    [
+        ("a/b/test_x.py::TestC::test_d", ["a.b.test_x", "TestC", "test_d"]),
+        ("test_x.py::test_p[1-a/b::c]", ["test_x", "test_p[1-a/b::c]"]),
+        ("a/b.pyc::t", ["a.b.pyc", "t"]),
+        ("", [""]),
+        ("[x]", ["[x]"]),
+    ],
+)
+def test_vendored_test_address(mod: ModuleType, address, expected) -> None:
+    assert mod.vendored_test_address(address) == expected
+    result = mod.vendored_test_address_variant(address)
+    assert isinstance(result, tuple)
+    assert result == tuple(expected)
+
+
+def test_matches_original(mod: ModuleType) -> None:
+    from _pytest.junitxml import mangle_test_address
+
+    for address in ["", "a/b.py::c[d]", "x.py::Y::z", "p[a/b.py]"]:
+        assert mod.vendored_test_address(address) == mangle_test_address(address)
+
+
+def test_respects_local_sep(mod: ModuleType, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mod.nodes, "SEP", "\\")
+    assert mod.vendored_test_address("a\\b.py::t") == ["a.b", "t"]
+    assert mod.vendored_test_address_variant("a\\b.py::t") == ("a.b", "t")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad", [None, 1, b"a.py::t"])
+def test_errors(mod: ModuleType, bad) -> None:
+    with pytest.raises((AttributeError, TypeError)):
+        mod.vendored_test_address(bad)
+    with pytest.raises((AttributeError, TypeError)):
+        mod.vendored_test_address_variant(bad)
+
+
+def test_module_not_registered_globally(mod: ModuleType) -> None:
+    assert "standalone_wave6_test_address_under_test" not in sys.modules
